status.summary: Former two-time UFC flyweight champion, now a contender. Snapped a two-fight skid with a split decision over Joseph Morales at Noche UFC (Sep 12, 2026; 28-29, 30-27, 30-27) after a five-round unanimous-decision loss to Lone'er Kavanagh in Mexico City (Feb 28, 2026) and his first career stoppage loss, a TKO from back control by Tatsuro Taira at UFC 323 (Dec 6, 2025). Booked against Charles Johnson at UFC 335 (Dec 12, 2026). Pro record 24-10-2; UFC 12-7-2.
status.ranking: #8 flyweight in the USA TODAY Sports/MMA Junkie media rankings (cited Oct 2026); other lists differ
status.next_fight: vs Charles Johnson, UFC 335, T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas, Dec 12, 2026

style.summary: A well-rounded veteran who leads with boxing at range and can wrestle, scramble and take the back when the chance comes. He has gone 25 minutes many times and rarely been stopped, but leg kicks and strong grapplers have beaten him in 2025-26.

moves.notes: Groups follow his target split in fighters.json: decayed significant attempts 82% head, 12% body, 6% legs (career 84/10/5); landed 70% head, 19% body, 12% legs. Head group is jab-first boxing (Yahoo's Morales recap: 'slick striking'), with a small head-kick weight. Body kicks lead the body group because his best-known finish is the UFC 277 body kick, and he landed 22 of 26 body strikes vs Morales and 15 of 21 vs Kavanagh. Leg strikes are rare but accurate (10/10 vs Morales, 13/14 vs Kavanagh); calf vs inside is split evenly because no source separates them. Clinch (4%) and ground (3%) shares are small, so knees and elbows stay low. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json, data/raw ufcstats per-fight stats, Yahoo and ESPN recaps.
